items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...in comparison to Coleman Hawkins' sound or even Ben Webster, you might say that his sound wasn't quite as big at times as Ben Webster's

ctx.x: And quite different from all the other great tenor saxophone players, you know, beautiful --
Yeah, because, you know, I had thought that from the records, because some people had said that he had a small sound.

Yeah, well, that goes along the way some people think. Of course, you might say that in comparison to Coleman Hawkins' sound or even Ben Webster, you might say that his sound wasn't quite as big at times as Ben Webster's
